Innovative Bubble Tea Flavors to Try in 2025 # Innovative Bubble Tea Flavors to Try in 2025 As we step into 2025, the bubble tea landscape continues to evolve with exciting new flavors that tantalize the taste buds. Here are some innovative bubble tea flavors you should definitely try this year.
Expo West 2025: BOBA CHiC’s Experience and Product Highlights # Attending Expo West 2025: BOBA CHiC’s Experience and Product Highlights Expo West 2025 was a vibe—and BOBA CHiC brought the flavor! As one of the world’s largest natural and organic product expos, Expo West is the place to showcase what’s next in food and beverage, and we were excited to participate.
Leveraging Social Media to Boost Your Bubble Tea Business # Leveraging Social Media to Boost Your Bubble Tea Business Want to get your bubble tea brand noticed? Social media is your best friend. Platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and even Pinterest are essential tools for building a strong brand presence and connecting with your audience.
The Evolution of Tapioca Pearls: From Classic to Innovative Variations # The Evolution of Tapioca Pearls: From Classic to Innovative Variations Tapioca pearls—also known as “boba”—have come a long way since they first made their chewy debut in Taiwan in the 1980s. Originally made from cassava starch and served in classic brown sugar milk tea, today’s pearls come in a variety of flavors and textures.
Exploring the Health Benefits of Traditional Asian Beverages # Exploring the Health Benefits of Traditional Asian Beverages When it comes to wellness, traditional Asian beverages have long been ahead of the curve. From antioxidant-rich matcha to gut-friendly herbal teas, these drinks pack more than just flavor—they’re steeped in health benefits.
The Art of Crafting the Perfect Bubble Tea at Home # The Art of Crafting the Perfect Bubble Tea at Home Craving bubble tea but want to skip the lines? You can totally make it at home—and yes, it can be just as good. With a few key ingredients and simple steps, you’ll be whipping up your own boba drinks in no time.
Sustainable Packaging in the Beverage Industry: BOBA CHiC’s Approach # Sustainable Packaging in the Beverage Industry: BOBA CHiC’s Approach In today’s eco-conscious world, sustainability is no longer just a buzzword—it’s a necessity. Our approach to sustainable packaging starts with smart material choices. We’ve swapped out traditional plastics for more environmentally friendly options.
Fusion Delights: Incorporating Bubble Tea Elements into Desserts # Fusion Delights: Incorporating Bubble Tea Elements into Desserts Why limit bubble tea to just a drink? At BOBA CHiC, we’re all about blending cultures and flavors—and that includes infusing boba magic into desserts. From creamy puddings to chewy cookies, here’s how you can get creative.
Creating a Unique Bubble Tea Menu: Tips for Attracting Customers # Creating a Unique Bubble Tea Menu: Tips for Attracting Customers A bubble tea menu isn’t just a list of drinks—it’s your brand’s personality on display. In today’s competitive market, having a distinctive, trend-savvy menu can make all the difference.
The Rise of Bubble Tea: Exploring Its Global Popularity # The Rise of Bubble Tea: Exploring Its Global Popularity Bubble tea, affectionately known as “boba,” has transcended its Taiwanese origins to become a global sensation. This delightful concoction of tea, milk, and chewy tapioca pearls offers a unique sensory experience that continues to win fans worldwide.

Evolution of BOBA CHiC: From Local Roots to Global Presence # Empire Eagle Food was founded in 2002, initially operating as a tea and raw material trading company. Over the years, we transformed into a diversified manufacturer, offering a wide range of beverage ingredients, ready-to-drink products, and innovative food solutions.
In 2018, we introduced our own brand, BOBA CHiC , driven by the belief that bubble tea is more than just a beverage—it represents a vibrant cultural experience. Since its inception, BOBA CHiC has rapidly gained recognition across various markets, expanding its footprint throughout Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East.
Our journey has included participation in major international food exhibitions and collaborations with global franchise brands. Throughout this growth, we have remained dedicated to innovation and quality, weaving the essence of Taiwanese tea culture into diverse lifestyles around the world.
Today, BOBA CHiC continues to craft drinks inspired by local traditions, resonating with global tastes and translating the unique flavors of Taiwan into a universal language of style and culture.

Simple & Fun – Taste the Trend at Home! # Explore a curated selection of recipes designed to bring the excitement of bubble tea and Asian-inspired treats into your own kitchen. Each recipe is crafted for simplicity and enjoyment, using BOBA CHiC kits and ingredients for authentic flavors and textures.
Tapioca Cube Sweet Grass Jelly Soup # Smooth grass jelly paired with chewy tapioca cubes for a refreshing treat.
Ingredients:
Sweet Grass Jelly Soup w/ Tapioca Cube Kit Steps:
Combine jelly powder with boiling water. Stir thoroughly until dissolved. Add tapioca cubes. Optionally, drizzle with honey or milk. Video Pop Caviar Ramen # A single bite delivers a burst of bold, savory flavor with popping boba.
Ingredients:
BOBA CHiC Pop Caviar Ramen Optional toppings: scallions, seaweed, eggs Steps:
Cook noodles in boiling water for 4–5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl or plate. Add the included sauce packet. Mix well until evenly coated. Top with a fried egg, scallions, or other preferred toppings. Drain the popping boba packet. Add popping boba (choose Spicy or Tomato flavor). Mix again and enjoy! Video Instant Popping Boba Cocktail # A party essential—fun, fizzy, and unforgettable.
Ingredients:
BOBA CHiC Popping Boba Cocktail Kit Ice bag Optional garnish Steps:
Open the ice pack and add the fruit tea powder. Pour in Sprite or sparkling water. Stir until the powder dissolves. Add COCKTAIL / MOCKTAIL popping boba. Insert a straw and enjoy the popping surprise! Video Black GABA Rice Matcha Amazake Tangyuan # A cozy fusion of health and tradition—warm, comforting, and unique.
Ingredients:
BOBA CHiC Black GABA Rice Matcha Amazake Latte Rice balls (store-bought or handmade) Steps:
Cook tangyuan (rice balls) until they float. Dissolve black GABA rice matcha amazake powder in hot water. Add the cooked tangyuan to the matcha amazake soup. Sweeten with sugar if desired. Video Boba Tea Egg Tart # A delightful East-meets-West treat—sweet, creamy, and chewy.
Ingredients:
BOBA CHiC Whipping Foam Bubble Tea Kit BOBA CHiC Bubble Tea Kit 2 eggs 20g sugar Tart shells Steps:
Mix milk tea, eggs, and sugar together. Pour the mixture into tart shells, filling to about 80%. Bake at 160°C (320°F) for 15 minutes. Prepare the whipping foam powder. Microwave BOBA CHiC instant boba for 20–30 seconds. Top the tarts with whipped foam. Drizzle with heated instant brown sugar tapioca boba. Video Fruity Popping Boba Salad # A colorful, refreshing, and guilt-free delight.
Ingredients:
BOBA CHiC Iced Popping Boba Fruit Tea Kit Seasonal vegetables and fruits (such as mango, kiwi, berries) Original yogurt Steps:
Mix fruit powder into the yogurt. Stir until smooth. Add salad greens and fruit to a bowl. Top with popping boba for juicy bursts. Drizzle the fruit yogurt over the salad. Mix and enjoy chilled. Video Need assistance or have questions? Contact Us Stay connected:

Taiwanese Tea Excellence: Quality, Craft, and Collaboration # BOBA CHiC is dedicated to showcasing the rich diversity and refined quality of Taiwanese tea. Our tea collection features a wide range of options, from internationally acclaimed gift boxes to convenient drip tea and premium pyramid tea bags, all sourced from carefully selected Taiwanese tea gardens.
Product Highlights # Distinctive Flavors: Each variety of Taiwanese tea offers a unique flavor and aroma, ranging from the refreshing notes of green tea to the robust character of oolong. This diversity highlights the depth of Taiwan’s tea culture. Thoughtful Packaging: Our packaging is designed not only to maintain the freshness of the tea leaves but also to reflect the aesthetic values of Taiwanese tea traditions. Whole-Leaf Pyramid Tea Bags: Unlike standard ground tea bags, our pyramid bags use whole tea leaves, resulting in a more complex and refined taste experience. Advantages of Our Tea Series # Pure Origins: All teas are sourced from select Taiwanese gardens, ensuring purity and high quality in every cup. Variety for Every Preference: We offer a broad selection of tea types to suit different tastes and needs. Rigorous Quality Control: Every production detail is carefully managed to guarantee the quality and integrity of each tea bag. Health Benefits: Taiwanese tea is naturally rich in antioxidants and offers a range of health benefits, making it a suitable choice for daily wellness. International Recognition # Our Award-Winning Tea Series has received the prestigious iTQi Three-Star award for three consecutive years, culminating in the Crystal Award in 2023. These accolades underscore our commitment to delivering exceptional quality to tea enthusiasts worldwide.
Partnership Opportunities # We invite global retailers, importers, wholesalers, and traders to join us in promoting the allure of Taiwanese tea. Our flexible partnership models include wholesale, agency, and brand licensing, supported by comprehensive product knowledge and marketing resources. If you are interested in collaborating, please reach out through our Contact Us page.
Explore Our Tea Categories # International Award-Winning Tea Gift Box TO-GO Drip Tea Bag Premium Tea Bag Commitment to Quality # At BOBA CHiC, we are passionate about sharing the authentic taste of Taiwanese tea with the world. Our dedication to quality, variety, and customer support ensures a rewarding experience for both tea lovers and business partners.
